reference_approach.architecture: Separate data transformation, application state, browser rendering, and external-service access where those concerns exist. Keep pure logic independently testable.
review_notes: Validate all user-provided data at the relevant boundary.
Handle errors and empty states explicitly.
Avoid putting secrets or trusted authorization logic in browser code.
Add repeatable tests and document runtime versions.

explanation: This is a reference planning solution for Offline-Capable Web Application, not a complete deployable implementation. Subject-matter reviewers should produce and test a complete implementation in an isolated project before publication.
